learner_operation: Locate a highlighted matrix entry, count its one-based row and column, and express the ordered indices in matrix-entry notation.

fixed_features.feature: One highlighted cell and one-based row before column
Small integer matrices; five radio options or source-supported symbolic/two-index blanks
fixed_features.justification: All nine source cases use these response workloads. Matrix values do not determine coordinates.

Conservative distractor extension preserves complete source banks; fixing their correct role is not justified. Current sampler instead chooses a bank placement with at least two in-matrix targets and varies the highlighted target.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any valid cell in observed small shapes; fixed bank controls can change which member is highlighted.
answer_roles.observed: 55 explicit shape/coordinate boundaries, including all 16 4x4 cells; all five roles in each source bank exercised.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Position and relative bank role must not identify the answer without reading the box.
answer_roles.observed: Current delivered batch has two radio groups, each with two different target roles and different correct-option positions. Controlled banks exercise every role.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Labels vary consistently; values may change while preserving coordinate response.
answer_roles.observed: Fresh labels vary; paired zero/one matrix controls preserve correct responses and update solution values.

coverage.result: Nine cases match complete answer banks and matrices. q139629 highlight restored from keys/solution; canonical example is an instructional demonstration without fields.
55 boundary assignments, 40 fresh individual records and 40 finite-batch candidates. All four templates and all five radio profiles appear across targeted samples.
5/5 accepted: four radio questions in two contrasting bank groups and one symbolic blank. The symbolic field has the separately reported comma-index grading defect.

counterfactuals.change: Move highlighted cell while holding matrix values, symbol, whole bank, layout and shuffle seed fixed.
counterfactuals.expected: Correct coordinate, selected option, positional explanation and native accepted response change; old response is rejected.
counterfactuals.observed: 22 relevant pairs update keys/solutions; native pair tests reject stale answers. Representative same-bank screenshots show z21 becoming z13.
counterfactuals.justification: Lesson defines the answer by row and column of the boxed cell.

counterfactuals.change: Replace all zero entries with ones, holding target and bank fixed.
counterfactuals.expected: Coordinate answer and native acceptance preserved; value equality in solution updates.
counterfactuals.observed: 27 irrelevant pairs preserve keys and native acceptance. Radio and symbolic solution conclusions update 0 to 1; two-index explanation correctly stays unchanged.
counterfactuals.justification: Entry magnitude is irrelevant to identifying row and column.

stages_examined: Generator valid-position and bank-placement domain (at least two eligible targets)
Finite batch pairing and output shuffling
Actual publisher validation and content normalization
Practice eligibility, history exclusions and weighted selection rules
delivery.result: 5/5 exact batch; 32/40 fresh batch records; 46/56 controls survive. Duplicate source-bank geometries and overlapping fixed-seed profile samples explain removals. Every surviving radio group retains contrasting targets. Selection may remove seen records and does not correct the grading defect.

limitations: No finite audit proves absence of all shortcuts. Conditional small groups are regression examples, not population estimates.
Review targets easy only. Authored moderate/hard are not certified.
No live learner histories, policy distribution or later inventory; selection claims are limited to captured basis5667 and inspected code.
Source replay preserves original answer arrangement by design and is not itself a varied practice pool.
Native grading accepts tested bracing, numeric fractions and added zero, but rejects valid comma-separated matrix indices; reported separately as grading.
Serialized option-position probes are distinguished from actual preview UI order; learner item IDs are unavailable.
